text:
Lia (PM): Quick thread to lock the console observability MVP for next quarter. Core asks: cost-by-route, low-overhead tracing hooks, and error-regression alerts. Need minimal launch gates.

Maya (Product): Sales pressure from Acme + FinSafe on cost-per-route and hosted vs dedicated comparison.

Devin (Eng): Engineering constraints: full-span indexing + 30d retention heavy. Suggest phased: metrics-first dashboard + trace-hooks-lite.

Sanjay (SRE): Propose SLOs up front: dashboard p95 <200ms, trace sampling overhead <15ms p95. Those will drive infra.

Lia (PM): Proposed MVP: (A) cost widget (top-10 routes, hosted/dedicated toggle), (B) trace-hooks: default low sampling + span attach API, (C) error analytics: route+model-version grouping + basic anomaly alerts. Launch gates: Acme demo, perf SLOs, retention/PII controls doc.

Devin (Eng): Default sampling suggestion:
```
sampling:
  global_rate: 0.01
  prioritized_routes: ['/v1/generate','/v1/embeddings']
  max_spans_per_trace: 50
```
Dedicated customers can increase.

Maya (Product): Retention trade: Hosted 14d, Dedicated/Private 30d. Expose upgrade UI with cost estimate.

Devin (Eng): UI should show estimated monthly delta (tokens + trace storage) before confirm. Backend can use prefix/KV caching to reduce re-ingest for cost calc.

Sanjay (SRE): Also require KMS metadata + retention controls for Private customers to close regulated deals.

Lia (PM): Action items:
- Lia: acceptance criteria + Acme demo runbook (Tue)
- Devin: trace-hooks perf spike (Fri)
- Maya: customer impact + pricing sketch (Wed)
- Sanjay: SLO test plan + infra cost delta 14d->30d (Fri)

observability-bot: deploy-bot: canary "trace-hooks-lite" started in staging at 1762611000, job=canary-traces-03, status=running.

Devin (Eng): Early staging: ~6ms p95 overhead at 1% sampling. Will post full numbers.

Maya (Product): If canary stable, schedule Acme demo next week.

Lia (PM): Good sync. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock MVP and start tickets. :thumbsup:
